destinationCopy.note: Phu Cam is named from the city page: two street numbers, fee check on arrival. Hero stays Ky Dai. Hon Chen, the museum, Duc Duc, and the night streets stay off the cards. Food files were not edited.

destinationQuality.note: Read against the dossier. Phu Cam sentence matches the city page and leaves the fee as check on arrival. Hero is Ky Dai, flag and wall, not a soldier. Fees still match Resolution 55. The four unpublished sights stay off the cards.

food.note: Food guide names Dong Ba, Hen Island, and Kim Long. No shop picks and no stall prices. Com hen has a page and no photo.

foodCopy.note: Dish lines follow Vietnam Tourism and the culture department. Banh mi unchanged. Neighbor bowls stay in Hoi An and Da Nang.

researchBase.note: Left out: hotel street, Phu Bai minutes, the 13 km versus about 15 km disagreement is printed not collapsed, flight times, the station door, which heritage-train clock, door-to-door road minutes, the Hanoi bus, Ca Hue wharf and hour, night-street closing hours. Pho Tay streets are now the three the city desk names. The Hue–Da Nang bus figure is the station company's own reply, with no second timetable.

researchAttractions.note: Left out: Hon Chen (one hall frame; river views are a speck), the royal antiquities museum (cannon yard and people photos rejected), Duc Duc (one hall frame; the gate is behind a fence; address lines disagree), and the night streets (no licensed night photo). Bao Quoc, Dieu De, and Phu Cam were already sourced.

researchFood.note: Left out: stall prices, shop picks, Dong Ba's street number, a banh beo street that is not a shop, and a che alley. Banh mi gains no new Hue sentence.

researchNightlife.note: Left out: closing hours, a walking-street timetable, Hai Ba Trung beyond the plan's name, and any bar pick. The 22:00 line is one business.

researchLifestyle.note: Left out: a cafe street, the quiet hour, and which south-bank block faces the water. One outline only: citadel morning from the published opening, then the river walk at dusk. No multi-day route.

researchContext.note: Left out: a festival ticket, dates after 2026, Hoi An door-to-door minutes, the Dong Hoi to Phong Nha ride, Lang Co beyond the train stop, and Bach Ma.
